paragraphs: At Framing World, we know that choosing the perfect frame or print is all about how it fits into your space. That’s why we offer exclusive Home Consultation Services—so you can make the right choices in the comfort of your own home.

Our Framing & Printing Specialists will visit you, understand your décor style, and help you select the ideal frame designs, matting, glass, or printing options. We’ll guide you through sizes, materials, and finishes, ensuring every piece complements your interiors beautifully.

founder.title: Mr. Kuldeep Sharma
paragraphs: Kuldeep Sharma, the visionary behind Framing World, was born in 1976 and brings over three decades of hands-on experience in the art and framing industry. With a deep-rooted passion for craftsmanship and an uncompromising eye for quality, he founded Framing World in 2005 with the mission to deliver the finest custom framing and archival printing solutions in India and beyond.

Driven by a commitment to excellence, Mr. Sharma has transformed Framing World into a trusted name among artists, collectors, galleries, and museums. His focus on using only the most premium materials and the latest techniques ensures that every frame not only protects but also elevates the value of the artwork it surrounds.
Under his leadership, Framing World continues to set industry standards, offering world-class framing services from its New Delhi studio to clients across the globe.
